response.label: complementary
response.rationale: The predicate `owned_by` indicates ownership of an item by an entity, while `has` indicates possession of an item by an entity. These predicates describe different aspects of the relationship between an entity and an item. `owned_by` specifies a legal or formal ownership, whereas `has` describes a more general state of possession. The action contexts further support this distinction: `owned_by` is used in contexts where ownership is established or transferred (e.g., `king_requests_information_and_gifts`), while `has` is used in contexts where possession is simply stated or acquired (e.g., `receive_rubies_from_impostor`, `receive_sapphires_from_robber_chief`). The different parameters and effects of the actions also highlight this difference. The `owned_by` action involves establishing a new ownership relationship, while the `has` action simply asserts or modifies an existing possession relationship. Therefore, the predicates are complementary because they represent distinct ways of describing the same relationship between an entity and an item.
